alternative_explanation: The observed benefit may be reproducible by a candidate-free constant bias correction inside the same harm budget, so the learned candidate may contribute no information beyond the protected causal baseline.

control_family.name: source-selected constant safe shift
control_family.selection_data: the eleven source domains for each outer target domain
control_family.tie_breaker: within 1e-12 prefer smaller absolute offset, then larger alpha, then larger signed offset

evaluation.primary_difference: domain-equal cell-macro MAE of nested PCHP minus candidate-free control

pass_gate: mean PCHP-minus-control difference below zero and upper endpoint of the 95% domain-cluster percentile bootstrap interval below zero
failure_interpretation: Do not claim candidate-specific information is necessary. Retain only the bounded causal projection contribution and redesign the candidate mechanism on a new validation surface.
implementation_equivalence_test: Numba recurrence matched prefix_causal_cellwise_projection at absolute tolerance 1e-15 for four alpha values on shuffled multi-cell synthetic trajectories.
